cost_budget_policy.launch_rule: A prospective full empty-root run may not launch while any authorized pre-GLOBAL node is BUDGET_REQUIRED_BEFORE_RUN or PERFORMANCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED_EXPECTED without an explicit external budget decision.
cost_budget_policy.measurement_rule: Do not sum shared measurements or infer full-science cost from focused tests.
cost_budget_policy.purpose: Operational ceilings and launch-readiness classifications, not fabricated runtime predictions.
